If Cruel Intentions 2 conflicts with the 1999 film or 2016 pilot, the 1999 film and its direct 2016 continuation control the selected adult branch; the conflict must be logged instead of silently merged.

The 2016 pilot is an unaired continuation, so this selected version is a clearly labeled Kira-project branch and not a claim that every franchise adaptation shares one timeline.
